case_number: 2024 INSC 239; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. 1738-39 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(CRL.) NOS. 3390-91 OF 2024)

parties.respondent: The State of Telangana and Ors.

summary: Preventive detention under Telangana Act, 1986; Goonda defined under Section 2(g) covering habitual offenders committing Chapter XVII IPC offences; ground cases from Madgul PS with chain snatching incidents; bail granted in two cases with conditions not affecting detention; extraneous considerations in detention order; vitiating factors including reliance on history cases outside commissionerate; advisory board role examined; HC judgment upholding detention set aside; detention order quashed.
legal_provisions_cited: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act, 1986 s.2(g)
Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act, 1986 s.3(2)
Indian Penal Code ch.16, ch.17, ch.22
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; detention order quashed.
